purpose: silver_ourairports_runways is the cleaned, one-row-per-runway view of bronze.ourairports_runways (10760 rows), carrying runway geometry, surface, lighting and closure status keyed by id and linked to airports via airport_ref and airport_ident. It feeds airport capability and runway-dimension analysis downstream.
usage: Read one row per runway id; join to the airport dimension on airport_ref or airport_ident. Lengths, widths, elevations and displaced thresholds are integers in feet, coordinates are DECIMAL(9,6) degrees, and lighting and closure are booleans (is_lighted, is_closed). Consumers must deliberately filter rows where le_ident_is_placeholder or he_ident_is_placeholder is true before treating runway-end designators as real, and must handle nulls in every geometry column rather than assuming zero.
limitations: Only Airbyte capture columns were removed; no rows were dropped and no values imputed, and duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 so no dedupe was applied. Runway-end geometry is incomplete: latitudes and longitudes are null for about 22 percent of rows (null_rate 0.220911 to 0.222212), elevations for about 28 percent (0.276208 and 0.276301), headings for about 23 percent, and displaced thresholds for 88 to 90 percent (0.884201 and 0.899907). surface is left unnormalised across 239 distinct spellings, he_heading_degt includes an out-of-range max of 362.0, and id, airport_ref and airport_ident remain text because sampling covered only 10 of 10760 values.
